definitions.explanation: A large structure with blades that rotate in the wind, used historically for grinding grain or pumping water, and now for generating electricity. Distinct from the toy pinwheel ({風車|かざぐるま}).

examples.japanese: オランダ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{風車|ふうしゃ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧だ。
examples.english: The Netherlands is famous for its windmills.

examples.japanese: ⟦{風力発電|ふうりょくはつでん}→風力発電：08742_fuuryokuhatsuden⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{風車|ふうしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{丘|おか}→丘：02183_oka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{並|なら}んでいる→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧。
examples.english: Wind turbines are lined up on top of the hill.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{風車|ふうしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{地下水|ちかすい}→地下水：09600_chikasui⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{汲|く}み{上|あ}げる⟦{仕組|しく}み→仕組み：07168_shikumi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{使|つか}われて→使う：00473_tsukau⟧きた。
examples.english: In this area, a system of using windmills to pump up groundwater has been used since ancient times.

notes:
{風車|ふうしゃ} refers to large wind-powered structures — both traditional windmills used for grinding grain or pumping water, and modern wind turbines for generating electricity.

PRONUNCIATION:
The same kanji can also be read as かざぐるま, which means a toy pinwheel. The reading ふうしゃ always refers to the large structure, while かざぐるま refers to the small toy. Be careful not to confuse the two readings.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {風車|ふうしゃ}{小屋|ごや}: windmill building
- ⟦{風力発電|ふうりょくはつでん}→風力発電：08742_fuuryokuhatsuden⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{風車|ふうしゃ}: wind power turbine
- {風車|ふうしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{回|まわ}る→回る：01150_mawaru⟧: the windmill turns/spins

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japan has invested heavily in wind power, and ⟦{風力発電|ふうりょくはつでん}→風力発電：08742_fuuryokuhatsuden⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{風車|ふうしゃ} (wind turbines) are a common sight in coastal and mountainous areas.
